idea: Build CrownCut, a luxury barber salon booking app with haircut & beard service menu, master stylist selection, appointment time slot picker, and booking receipt confirmation
tagline: Bespoke Grooming & Master Barber Booking for the Modern Gentleman
targetAudience: High-net-worth clients seeking premium, white-glove salon experiences, alongside boutique grooming lounges, luxury barbershops, and elite master stylists requiring an elevated digital presence.

mvpFeatures.name: Bespoke Service Menu
mvpFeatures.description: Tailored grooming service selection (haircut, beard sculpting, luxury hot-towel treatment) featuring transparent tier pricing and customizable consultation durations.

mvpFeatures.name: Master Stylist Showcase
mvpFeatures.description: Individual barber portfolios showcasing high-res galleries, credentials, specialties, ratings, and tiered pricing based on stylist seniority.

mvpFeatures.name: Precision Slot & Concierge Picker
mvpFeatures.description: Real-time calendar engine allowing exact time selection with options to lock in beverage preferences (e.g., Single Malt, Espresso) and scalp sensitivities prior to arrival.

mvpFeatures.name: Luxury Digital Receipt & Calendar Sync
mvpFeatures.description: Sleek, high-contrast confirmation receipt with 1-click Google/Apple Calendar integration, direct map navigation, and instant booking summary.

mvpFeatures.name: Concierge Client Vault
mvpFeatures.description: Personalized client profile recording visual haircut history notes, preferred styles, and bespoke service tags for seamless repeat bookings.

futureFeatures.name: VIP Retainer & Grooming Subscriptions
futureFeatures.description: Monthly recurring membership engine granting priority slot booking, unlimited touch-ups, and exclusive salon lounge access.

futureFeatures.name: White-Label Brand Customization
futureFeatures.description: Custom salon branding capabilities allowing elite barbershop chains to feature their own logos, custom themes, and exclusive domain integration.

futureFeatures.name: In-App Stylist Consultation Chat
futureFeatures.description: Direct, secure messaging between clients and master stylists for pre-service image sharing and custom style consultations.

userPersonas.name: Julian - C-Suite Executive
painPoints: Frustrated by mass-market booking apps with cheap, utilitarian design
Dislikes repeating haircut specifications and drink choices on every visit
Requires tight, reliable scheduling that syncs with personal assistant calendars
goals: Book a top-tier master stylist in under 30 seconds with total confidence
Experience a white-glove, tailored service with preferred drink ready upon arrival
Maintain a polished appearance via recurring priority slots

userPersonas.name: Marcus - Salon Founder & Master Barber
painPoints: Generic booking platforms undermine his salon's high-end brand identity
Marketplace apps charge high commissions and attempt to redirect his loyal client data
Inability to easily set tiered pricing for senior vs junior barbers
goals: Present an ultra-premium digital storefront matching his salon's gold-standard aesthetic
Retain 100% ownership of high-net-worth client relationships and history
Maximize revenue through master stylist tier pricing and VIP memberships

userJourneys.description: The end-to-end journey for a client selecting a luxury service, customizing concierge preferences, and confirming an appointment.
steps: Open CrownCut and view featured luxury service menu
Select desired service (e.g., 'Royal Cut & Beard Sculpt')
Browse Master Stylist portfolio carousel and select preferred barber
Pick precision time slot on the high-contrast interactive date picker
Specify concierge choices (Select complimentary beverage & enter hair preference note)
Confirm booking and save animated digital luxury receipt to calendar

userJourneys.description: How a master stylist logs client notes and captures portfolio photos after a appointment.
steps: Stylist opens CrownCut Barber Portal post-service
Accesses completed appointment card for the client
Uploads fresh haircut photos directly to client vault and public portfolio
Logs updated blade settings and scalp notes for the client's next visit

screens.name: Salon Showcase & Menu Screen
screens.purpose: Primary landing screen highlighting salon ambiance, featured grooming treatments, and quick rebooking shortcuts.

screens.name: Master Stylist Showcase Screen
screens.purpose: Displays detailed credentials, high-res lookbook galleries, customer ratings, and tier pricing for specific barbers.

screens.name: Precision Slot & Concierge Screen
screens.purpose: Allows clients to select exact time slots and input bespoke concierge preferences prior to checkout.

screens.name: Luxury Confirmation Receipt Screen
screens.purpose: Provides high-end confirmation with smooth animations, calendar integrations, and salon directions.
keyComponents: Add to Apple / Google Calendar Button

screens.name: Concierge Client Vault Screen
screens.purpose: Manages client grooming history, saved preferences, past visit photos, and VIP memberships.

routes.name: Services
routes.description: Main service menu and salon overview tab

routes.name: Stylists
routes.description: Master stylist directory and portfolio showcase tab

routes.name: Booking
routes.description: Time slot and preference customization screen

routes.name: Receipt
routes.description: Post-booking digital receipt and calendar sync view

routes.name: Vault
routes.description: Personal grooming vault and past appointments profile tab

techStack.frontend: React Native / Expo (TypeScript) with NativeWind & Reanimated for premium gold-accent UI animations
techStack.backend: Node.js / Fastify (TypeScript) built with clean modular architecture
techStack.database: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM & Redis for real-time slot lock caching
techStack.auth: Supabase Auth (Passwordless Magic Links & Apple Sign-In)
techStack.hosting: AWS Elastic Beanstalk for API & Vercel for Web Admin Portal

monetizationModel: B2B SaaS subscription model charged to salon owners (Monthly flat fee per active master stylist seat) plus optional zero-commission VIP Client Retainer management add-ons.
